query:
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.email, t.status, t.userId, t.openId,
       u.openId as userOpenId, u.email as userEmail
FROM technicians t
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.userId
WHERE t.userId IS NOT NULL AND (t.openId IS NULL OR t.openId = '');
